00048 /**
00049  * @brief               Create a radio button control widget
00050  *
00051  * This function creates a new radio button control widget.
00052  *
00053  * The hGroup argument is a handle to an opaque data structure used by the
00054  * system to associate related radio buttons.  When creating the first radio
00055  * button in a group, the application must set *hGroup to NULL.  Thereafter,
00056  * as additional radio buttons are added to the group, the same hGroup
00057  * argument must be used.
00058  *
00059  * @param id            IN:     Unique ID for the widget, defined by app,
00060  *                              or kHxWidgetAutoID to auto-generate the ID
00061  * @param pParent       IN:     Pointer to "parent" widget containing button
00062  * @param pText         IN:     Text for the button label, or NULL
00063  * @param x             IN:     x coordinate for the top left button origin
00064  * @param y             IN:     y coordinate for the top left button origin
00065  * @param hRadioButton  OUT:    Handle to the new radio button;
00066  *                              *hRadioButton is NULL on failure
00067  * @param hGroup        IN/OUT: Handle to the radio button group
00068  *
00069  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.  Returns
00070  *                              HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails,
00071  *                              and sets *hRadioButton to NULL.
00072  *
00073  **/
00074 HxResult HxRadioButtonNew(uint32_t id, HxWidget_t* pParent,
00075                             const char* pText, int32_t x, int32_t y,
00076                             HxRadioButton_t** hRadioButton,
00077                             HxRadioGroup_t** hGroup);
00078 
00079 /**
00080  * @brief               Delete a radio button widget
00081  *
00082  * This function deletes a radio button created from an earlier call to
00083  * HxRadioButtonNew.  Deleting the last radio button in a group sets the
00084  * group to NULL.
00085  *
00086  * It is not necessary to call this function when quitting the application,
00087  * since the widget's parent calls this function just before the parent is
00088  * deleted.  HxRadioButtonDelete only needs to be called when removing a
00089  * radio button at runtime.
00090  *
00091  * @param pRadioButton  IN:     Pointer to the radio button to delete
00092  *
00093  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.
00094  *
00095  **/
00096 HxResult HxRadioButtonDelete(HxRadioButton_t* pRadioButton);
